evidence.limits: No whisper.srt available; speech is taken from burned-in word-by-word captions (complete for 0-5 s, sampled once a second afterwards, so many words are missed and the dialogue cannot be reconstructed). The Reel is published by nirolevy1 (collab with matan.nistor). Which of the two men is Matan is inferred: at 36 s the dark-haired man says a caption 'מתן' while gesturing at the other man, so I code the lighter-haired bearded man as Matan; the faces were not otherwise verified. Music and sound effects not determinable. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Comic announcement skit in IDF-style uniforms: Matan joins Nir Levy's company 'ממדים לריבועים' (a fitness and weight-loss programme for soldiers) as a partner, with a free month for new sign-ups (stated in caption).
audience: Israeli soldiers and young people wanting to lose weight or get fit; the two creators' followers.
caption_vs_video_note: Caption is a formal announcement (Matan joins as a partner, a month free for every new sign-up to the programme, follow both pages) and is consistent with the video, but the video is a staged military sketch, not a plain announcement. The topic is not Matan's usual business content: it is a fitness company partnership. The cover is a designed poster of the two men with the title 'מוכנים לזה?' and 'ניסטור x נירו לוי'.

opening.first_frame: A soldier in a bucket hat with a gold 'M' logo bends over a table writing on a paper in a green field; a yellow caption in the upper third: 'אי שם בבסיסי צה״ל'.
opening.s0_1: Static shot of the seated soldier writing; caption held.
opening.s1_3: Unchanged: the soldier writes and the caption stays.
opening.s3_5: At 3.67 s a cut to a second soldier running toward the table across a yard; at 4.75 s he leans over the table; the caption 'חייל!' appears at about 5 s in large white type.
opening.visual_hook: A military-sketch setup with an establishing caption, then a running soldier.
opening.spoken_hook: No speech in the first 5 s (establishing shot); the first spoken word is the shout 'חייל!' at about 5 to 5.6 s, then 'מה זה? אתה חותם קבע?' from 6.4 s (machine transcript)
opening.payoff_promised_at_s: never stated (the partnership announcement arrives at about 32 s)
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: 'אי שם בבסיסי צה״ל' is a self-contained scene caption
opening.works_without_sound: partly: the setting is clear but the joke needs the dialogue captions that start at 5 s

visual.subject_placement: Two actors in uniform in alternating over-the-shoulder shots in the skit; later they stand side by side facing the camera.
visual.setting: An outdoor base-style yard with a folding table, plastic chairs, trees and a fence; sunset-like warm light.
visual.color_contrast: Olive uniforms against green and blue sky, with bold white captions and the gold and green company logo.
visual.props_and_gestures: Bucket hats with the 'M' logo, a table, a form and a pen, a phone for 'deciding', clasped hands, expressive gestures, exaggerated faces.
visual.supporting_footage: Money-bag emoji face effect (28 s), a handshake clip (30 s) with a blur-whip transition, two Instagram profile screenshots (@nirolevy1 and @matan.nistor) inset in the lower half (50 to 52 s), a round green and gold company badge pop (38 and 42 s), and a company end card (57 to 60 s).
visual.persistent_branding: Round green-and-gold 'ממדים לריבועים' badge appears at 38 s and 42 s; an 'M' logo on the hats throughout.
visual.visual_progression: 0-3.7 s soldier writing; 3.7-6 s second soldier runs in and says 'חייל!'; 6-30 s dialogue skit as a recruiter tries to sign Matan in the 'company' (money-bag eyes at 28 s, handshake at 30 s); 31 s whip-blur transition; 32-56 s both men stand and speak to camera, with profile inset at 50 s; 57-60.9 s company end card.
visual.cover_matches_video: partly: the cover is an edited poster of the two men (one with a vest, the other bare-chested, the 'M' logo) with 'מוכנים לזה? ניסטור x נירו לוי', which looks different from the uniformed video.
visual.ui_interference: The Instagram profile screenshots at 50 to 52 s occupy the lower half (bottom 35 percent zone) and overlap the captions; the end card text runs high at about 18 to 40 percent of the height.

editing.edit_function: Mostly comedy timing and clarity: shot-reverse-shot dialogue, an emoji face filter for the money joke, a whip blur between the skit and the direct address, and profile screenshots to show viewers where to follow.
pacing_changes: t=3.7-30s: fast shot-reverse-shot cuts every 1 to 3 s
t=31s: whip-blur cut into the direct announcement
t=32-56s: longer shots with the two men side by side
editing.ending: The two men laugh and shake hands (55 s), a blurred sweep, then an end card in green text 'חברת ממדים לריבועים מצדיעה לשותף החדש: מתן ניסטור' above the round company badge for about 4 s.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: the sketch and the number of cuts make it replayable, though the end card is a static promo.

sound.delivery: Loud and fast, at about -9 to -14 dB through the sketch, with a near silence of -24 to -30 dB around 6 to 8 s and brief dips later; the announcement part is around -13 to -16 dB. The first 3.5 s are loud (about -11 dB) even though the soldier only writes, so there is probably ambient or music sound under the establishing shot.
sound.sfx: inferred: a whoosh likely accompanies the blur transition at 31 s (visual cue only)
sound.sync: Word-by-word captions follow the dialogue; the emoji face effect appears on the 'millions' line.

text.colour_coding: Yellow for the establishing line 'אי שם בבסיסי צה״ל'; white for all dialogue words; green for the company name in the end card and white for the person's name.
text.placement: Centre of the frame for dialogue; the top third for the establishing line; the end card at the top half.
text.style: Bold white sans with a soft shadow, one word at a time; a large white word 'חייל!' at 5 s.
text.density_and_read_time: One word per beat; fast but readable.
text.language: Military-sketch slang ('חייל!', 'מגייס', 'סיסטמים', 'שותף'), numbers vague ('מיליונים'); direct announcement lines ('כניסתו של מתן לחברת ממדים לריבועים', 'ההשמנה הצה״לית', 'גוף שלכם').
text.caption_structure: Greeting to soldiers, the announcement of the partnership and the aim of the company in the 'war on IDF obesity', then a free month for every new sign-up, and a request to follow both pages; emoji bullets; no hashtags.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew renders correctly; the abbreviation 'צה״ל' with its gershayim and the word 'הצה״לית' render fine; some captions show split-word quotes (a mirrored quotation mark near 23 s).

story.setup: At a base, one soldier asks another 'are you signing on for good?' and gets the answer that he is buying shares in the company (machine transcript, about 6 to 10 s).
story.stakes: Joining the company as a partner, with millions in the offer.
story.progression: Roll call 'חייל!', 'are you signing on?' / 'I am buying shares in your company', the fight against 'IDF obesity', three years of building the company and thousands of soldiers versus one day of help, 'how many millions might change your decision' (emoji face shows money), 'my partner!' at 29 s, a handshake, then the announcement to camera at 31 to 49 s that Matan Nistor joins as a partner, and the ask to follow both pages.
story.payoff: Announcement that Matan joins the company 'ממדים לריבועים' and a free month for new sign-ups (caption).
story.resolution: End card with the company badge.
story.payoff_delivered: yes: the reveal of the partnership arrives at about 32 s
friction_points: t=0-3.7s: a static opening with nothing said (interpretation)
t=6-30s: dialogue captions are hard to follow word by word (interpretation)
t=32-56s: the announcement is long for a sketch (interpretation)

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 43 comments is not representative. Almost entirely congratulations and cheering ('מטורף בהצלחה', 'איזה שילוב מנצח'), emoji, and one question about whether reservists are accepted; no criticism in this sample, which differs sharply from his solo Reels.
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: Heart or laughing emoji replies to individual commenters.

conversion.offer: A free month for every new sign-up to the 'ממדים לריבועים' programme (caption).
conversion.benefit: Dream body, confidence and keeping it for good (caption).
conversion.proof: none beyond the two creators and the badge
conversion.urgency: implied by 'in honour of the joining' (caption), no deadline
conversion.funnel_entry_visible: Follow-both-pages ask; no link or keyword on screen (the profile screenshots show bio links too small to read).
conversion.cta_fits_content: yes: the whole video is the announcement of the partnership
conversion.destination: The programme or the creators' profiles (inset); the sign-up page is not visible.

pair_match.notes: n/a (top Reel; dossier pair is null)

rights_and_privacy: Uniform-style costumes with the IDF acronym in captions ('צה״ל'); no third-party film. Faces of two creators only. The company badge and Nir Levy's brand are not Matan's own and would need his permission.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a comedy sketch in military costumes is more watchable than a plain announcement, the cast of two creators merges two audiences, and the follow ask is simple; shares are the highest in this set (455 and 2.6 per 1,000 views).
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: the product (a fitness programme for soldiers) is far from his business content, and the sketch dialogue is hard to follow from fast captions.

standout_moments.what: Large 'חייל!' as the second soldier arrives: the comedy beat in the first 6 seconds.
Money-bag emoji eyes: a visual gag for the 'millions' line.
Whip blur transition from the skit to the direct announcement.
Two Instagram profile screenshots appear for the follow ask.
